Identified as this saint because: Commons describes it as a Greek or Russian Orthodox icon of Saint Triphyllius. Triphyllius is a single name in the calendar — the bishop of Leukosia and disciple of Spyridon of Trimythous who died about 370, which is this folder's office and date — so there is no namesake to confuse him with. Commons describes it: Saint Triphyllius Greek or Russian orthodox icon.
